sentences.en: You may live to see man-made horrors beyond your comprehension.
sentences.zh: 你或许能看到超乎你理解范围的人造恐怖。

sentences.en: Ready comprehension requires concentration, focusing entirely on one's reading.
sentences.zh: 充分的理解需要集中注意力，完全专注于阅读。

sentences.en: My comprehension of complex subjects like these is limited.
sentences.zh: 我对这类复杂主题的理解有限。

senses.zh: 理解(力)，领悟(力)；理解力测试，阅读理解(练习)；(语言学习中的)理解训练
